name: IDOR
attack_surface: Resource identifier parameters in URL paths, query parameters, or JSON payloads
common_misconfigurations: Using sequential integers for object IDs without authentication lookup
Relying solely on frontend UI hiding of element links to restrict access
Missing cross-tenant checking constraints in relational database queries
validation_methods: Test endpoint access with separate account authorization token
Omit auth headers or exchange with guest roles
evidence_requirements: Raw HTTP Request/Response headers with tampered ID showing non-owned data retrieval
Evidence of cross-tenant modifications or delete operations
false_positive_indicators: Mocked endpoints returning similar empty profile template fields for all request IDs
WAF blocking requests based on header mismatch policies
reporting_guidance: High priority focus area. Cross-tenant read/write must be clearly demonstrated with two distinct account credentials.
